exercises.explanationUz:
YAKUNIY TEST - 1-15-UNITLAR, 20 ta
  bo'shliq (40 daqiqa).

  UNDOV: HOW clever of you!; WHAT a
    lovely dress!
  ShART: If I WERE you, I wouldn't
  QO'ShILISh: SO do I
  OB-HAVO: WHAT is the weather
    like?; It's FREEZING cold
  MAJHUL: Who was America
    discovered BY?
  PAST PERFECT: hadn't seen SINCE
    last Monday; didn't go to bed
    UNTIL he had finished
  KO'ChIRMA BUYRUQ: asked me TO
    stop
  TOO/ENOUGH: ENOUGH time; TOO
    short to reach
  TAG: works as a lawyer, DOESN'T
    she?
  Boshqa: insists ON going; Do THE
    Smiths own?; HOW do you travel?;
    What does it LOOK like?; a JAR
    of honey; Have you EVER flown?;
    FINE, thanks.


⚠ 'FREEZING COLD':

  = muzdek sovuq.


⚠ 'TO INSIST ON':

  = ... da turib olmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
YAKUNIY TEST - LUG'AT VA
  GRAMMATIKA.

  1 CURRENT events = joriy voqealar
  2 the CHEAPEST skirt of all
  3 He WON'T DO anything until she
    finishes (kelajak + until +
    present)
  4 STUDYING Maths at university
  5 a great learning TOOL = o'quv
    vositasi
  6 a BAG of flour = bir qop un
  7 a dark COMPLEXION = qoramag'iz
    teri
  8 in FAVOUR of = tarafdori
  9 the cleverest student IN his
    class
  10 the correct TIME = to'g'ri vaqt


⚠ 'IN FAVOUR OF':

  = ... tarafdori, ... ni qo'llab.

exercises.explanationUz:
MULOQOT IBORALARI - YAKUNIY.

  1 Muloyim so'rov → And COULD I
    HAVE some biscuits, too?
  2 Qayta so'rash → what DID YOU
    SAY your name was?
  3 Afsus → WHAT A pity!
  4 Uzrga javob → Never MIND.
  5 Maslahat → Why DON'T YOU TAKE
    some cough medicine?


⚠ 'WHAT A PITY!':

  = qanday achinarli!


⚠ 'BRAND NEW':

  = yap-yangi.


⚠ 'OUT OF TOWN':

  = shaharda emas, safarda.

sentencePatterns.formula: How + SIFAT + of you! / What a + OT!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How clever of you to do this! What a lovely dress!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buni qilganingiz qanday aqllilik! Qanday chiroyli ko'ylak!

sentencePatterns.formula: If I were you, I wouldn't + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I wouldn't eat so many sweets.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, buncha shirinlik yemasdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + didn't + FE'L + until + KIM + had + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He didn't go to bed until he had finished his homework.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uy vazifasini tugatmaguncha uxlagani yotmadi.
